maybe_get_arg_optional_string: use maybe_get_arg to parse an optional string argument from the command line by name
maybe_get_arg_boolean_flag: use maybe_get_arg with boolean_arg=True to parse a boolean flag from the command line
maybe_get_arg_positional: use maybe_get_arg with positional=True to parse a positional argument from the command line
maybe_get_arg_positional_indexed: use maybe_get_arg with positional=True and position to parse a positional argument at a specific index
maybe_get_arg_safe_parse: use maybe_get_arg to safely parse a CLI argument that may not be present without raising errors
